non_claims: Episode micro-agents are not identified students.

participatory_service.mechanism: 用诉求收集、服务扩容和群体对话提升承接能力与程序正当性；优势是包容和持续，风险是早期澄清速度较慢、资源成本更高。

uncertainty.interval: paired-seed mean 95% t interval; it is not population sampling uncertainty or a causal confidence interval
